High-end stylized painterly game concept art with chunky readable silhouette and strong highlights, front three-quarter full body centered, dark charcoal ruined stone background with minimal detail, warm gold dominates to contrast blue/purple/black bosses. No extra creatures, no words, no watermark, no UI. This is concept art and future icon reference, not a 3D model. Keep face, circular coin body and limbs clearly readable for small icons.
